name: codex-tps-plus
description: Show delayed TTFT and throughput, with an opt-in native OTel TBT reference.

interface.shortDescription: Delayed TTFT plus request and whole-turn throughput for Codex CLI.
interface.longDescription: Shows delayed turn TTFT, model-request throughput including TTFT, and end-to-end turn throughput after Codex CLI responses. An explicit localhost OTel experiment can add a native TBT-derived reference, but unjoinable telemetry is never labeled as current-turn TPS.
defaultPrompt: Show the latest Codex request throughput and session average.
Show the latest backfilled TTFT and explain its delayed timing.
